dog.description_text:
Leilani is an adorable little puppy with a big personality! She came to ARF all the way from California, where she was found as a stray with her sister. Now safe at ARF, she’s ready to learn the ropes of East End life!
Like any puppy, Leilani will need a little guidance as she learns the basics, including housebreaking and basic obedience. With patience, consistency, and plenty of love, she’ll be well on her way to becoming the best pup she can be!
